description: Gancarski, Pawel and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The database selects observations from Glasgow dynamic-stall tests, NREL/OSU pitching tests, CENER pitch/flap experiments at DTU, and ForWind tailored-inflow tests. The source identifies the tested airfoils and sinusoidal pitch, flap or inflow conditions. These components support analysis and validation of unsteady aerodynamic tools for wind-turbine blades. They are retained as one published collection with distinct experimental origins, without assuming a uniform measurement schema or identical sampling rates. Full-scale rotor performance is not inferred directly from these airfoil experiments. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
